name: By The Light raises Valkyr's Calling's crit chance by 50% (#951)
contract: By The Light 680620 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 33) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (7), EffectSpellClassMask word B = 16 (bit 4), EffectBasePoints 49 resolving to +50 with DieSides 1. Valkyr's Calling (Damage) 570034 carries SpellFamilyFlags word B = 16, the exact same bit, so SpellInfo::IsAffected(33, mask) admits it. Native path: Player::ApplySpellMod accumulates this SPELLMOD_FLAT modifier whenever the crit chance of spell 570034 is computed, with no script required. This scenario drives that call through the harness's spell_modifier metric.
